question: Which of the following statements about basketball equipment specifications is accurate?

options.text: The backboard must be 1.05 meters wide and 1.80 meters tall.
The diameter of the ring must be exactly 450 mm.
The lines on the backboard must be white and 50 mm wide.
The net must be black with 10 loops to attach it to the ring.

solution:
The correct answer is __**The lines on the backboard must be white and 50 mm wide**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• According to the official basketball equipment specifications set by the International Basketball Federation (FIBA), the **lines on the backboard must be white and 50 mm wide**.
 
• The backboard markings include a rectangle above the basketball hoop, which helps players aim and measure their shots accurately.
 
• These specifications ensure uniformity across basketball courts worldwide, maintaining consistency for professional and amateur games.
 
• Such precise measurements for the lines are critical for adhering to international standards and ensuring fair play.
 
• The **color white** is chosen for the lines for maximum visibility against the standard backboard material, which is often transparent or dark-colored.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: The backboard must be 1.05 meters wide and 1.80 meters tall.**

 
 
• This statement is incorrect. As per FIBA regulations, the standard dimensions of the backboard are **1.80 meters wide and 1.05 meters tall**, but the phrasing in the option reverses the dimensions.
 
• The backboard's dimensions are standardized to ensure uniformity in gameplay across courts globally.
 
• The backboard is typically made of a transparent material like tempered glass to allow visibility for spectators and players.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: The diameter of the ring must be exactly 450 mm.**
 
 
• This statement is incorrect. The official diameter of the basketball hoop (ring) is **450 mm to 459 mm**, as per FIBA standards.
 
• The inner edge of the ring must have this precise measurement to ensure compatibility with the standard basketball size (No. 7 for men and No. 6 for women).
 
• The ring is made of steel and must be securely attached to the backboard to withstand the force of dunks and other game actions.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: The net must be black with 10 loops to attach it to the ring.**
 
 
• This statement is incorrect. The net used in basketball is typically made of white cord, not black, for better visibility during gameplay.
 
• The net is attached to the ring using **12 loops**, not 10, ensuring it hangs evenly around the hoop.
 
• The net's primary function is to slow the ball down after a successful basket, making it easier to identify a score.
 
 
 
• **Main Theme: Basketball Equipment Specifications**
 
 
• Basketball equipment, including the backboard, hoop, net, and court lines, must adhere to precise specifications set by governing bodies like FIBA and the NBA.
 
• These regulations ensure consistency and fairness in the game, regardless of where it is played.
 
• Key elements like the dimensions of the backboard, the diameter of the hoop, and the visibility of court markings are all standardized for professional and amateur play.
